visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair, wearing a beige vest over a white long-sleeved blouse, sits at a large red desk. She is turned away from the camera, looking at two computer monitors displaying data and calendars in a professional clinic setting. (2) A sharp transition to a close-up image of a person's forehead. The skin appears textured, rough, and uneven with small pinkish bumps. (3) The view shifts to a close-up of another forehead area, this time showing remarkably smooth, glass-like skin texture under bright light. (4) The camera returns to the woman at the desk. She is sitting in a black ergonomic chair, occasionally gesturing towards the monitors while engaging in a discussion. (5) A high-detail close-up of a face shows significant skin shedding and intense redness around the lower cheeks and jawline, illustrating a physical reaction to treatment. (6) The video concludes with a clean white graphic overlay featuring the clinic's logo, contact numbers, and social media handles.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A confident male voice initiates a lecture-style monologue with a fast speech rate and high pitch variability, set against a bright, steady acoustic guitar BGM. (2) A female voice interjects briefly with a soft, inquisitive tone, questioning her sensitivity. (3) The male voice immediately responds with high arousal and authoritative intensity, using a series of sharp digital 'pop' sound effects to punctuate key words about skin roughness and treatment. (4) The interplay continues with the male voice dominating the mix, providing technical explanations with enunciated clarity, while the BGM maintains a consistent upbeat rhythm in the background. (5) As images of peeling skin are shown, the male voice adopts a more dramatic, emphasizing tone, ending with a professional summary as the BGM fades slightly.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate viewers on the effectiveness and expected physical reactions (like peeling and redness) of high-strength A-acid skin treatments at the DRX Dermatology Clinic. The video aims to normalize side effects as a part of the healing process for smoother skin.
